observed_value: cost_currency values U_AUD/U_CAD/U_EUR on flagged rows
anchor_value: schedule cost and fair value columns are USD-denominated

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Ancora Bidco PTY LTD (6) | Unitranche First Lien Term Loan | B + 500, 50 Floor | 9.00% | 11/2030 | AUD 5,191 | Cost 3,370 | Fair Value 3,617
Aryeh Bidco Investment Ltd. (6) | Unitranche First Lien Term Loan | S + 500, 75 Floor | 7.31% | 01/2033 | CAD 35,000 | Cost 24,967 | Fair Value 24,907

findings.detail: The non-USD unit belongs to the principal/par column, while cost and fair value are reported in USD on the schedule.

rationale: FX03 is a real data error. The filing schedule is in thousands and foreign-country subtotals print dollar signs for cost and fair value, while individual foreign debt rows place AUD/CAD/EUR in the principal amount column. The flagged cost_currency values therefore reflect a unit carried over from principal/par rather than the cost column.
